contract_source: G.14.11 design plus the placement, executable, pipe, and publication clauses in the G.14.12 artifacts

criteria.design_coverage: A non-administrator local account that is not the interactive SID. Medium-integrity control is the claimed scope. Elevated administrators are outside the claim.
criteria.evidence: None. The account does not exist.
criteria.missing: An account whose medium-integrity interactive user cannot reconfigure it
criteria.residual: This account may be able to elevate. That was not tested.

criteria.requirement: Interactive user cannot impersonate the receiver
criteria.design_coverage: Receiver refuses sender handles. Pipe server must not call ImpersonateNamedPipeClient. Client must match server SID, not the pipe name.
criteria.evidence: G.14.10 token lacked SeImpersonatePrivilege, SeTcbPrivilege, and SeCreateTokenPrivilege. That does not prove impersonation is impossible.
criteria.missing: A test that a medium-integrity process cannot obtain the receiver token

criteria.requirement: Interactive user cannot modify the receiver executable
criteria.design_coverage: Executable and the runtime it loads sit on the same protected ancestor chain. User PATH and site-packages are not used.
criteria.missing: Ownership and a failed write test
criteria.residual: A user-writable interpreter would defeat a separate SID

criteria.requirement: Interactive user cannot modify receiver configuration
criteria.design_coverage: Configuration file uses the same owner and DACL as the executable. Inherited user environment is discarded.
criteria.missing: The file and a failed write test

criteria.requirement: Interactive user cannot replace the receiving directory
criteria.design_coverage: Directory is created by the receiver SID. Medium-integrity rename must fail before any transfer.
criteria.evidence: G.14.8 showed the opposite for a directory this user owns. That location is forbidden.
criteria.missing: The same test against a receiver-owned directory

criteria.requirement: Interactive user cannot replace any relevant ancestor
criteria.design_coverage: Every ancestor from the volume root through the parent must deny the interactive SID the rights listed in the ancestor contract. No concrete path is approved.
criteria.evidence: None. G.14.11 had not enumerated ancestors.
criteria.missing: A real chain and a failed rename at each level
criteria.residual: One writable ancestor restores CreateFileW substitution

criteria.requirement: Interactive user cannot grant itself write through the DACL
criteria.design_coverage: Interactive SID has no WRITE_DAC. Owner is the receiver SID, not the interactive user.
criteria.evidence: No DACL was read. Same-user owners can rewrite their own DACLs. That is why the owner must not be the interactive user.
criteria.source: G.14.8 ACL finding; G.14.12 ancestor contract
criteria.residual: An owner or an elevated admin can still change a DACL. Admin resistance is not claimed.

criteria.requirement: Interactive user cannot take ownership to bypass the ACL
criteria.design_coverage: Interactive SID has no WRITE_OWNER. Medium-integrity take-ownership must fail.
criteria.evidence: Not tested. Elevated take-ownership is out of scope.

criteria.requirement: Receiver does not trust sender-supplied paths
criteria.design_coverage: Sender sends bytes only. Directory handles from the sender are refused.
criteria.evidence: Design only. open_directory still exists in tests/g14_7_fs.py and must not be the receiver entry.
criteria.missing: An implementation that has no path parameter

criteria.design_coverage: SHA-256 of handle read-back, then inspect_wheel_bytes. Sender manifest is not authority.
criteria.evidence: Helpers exist. They were not run as a receiver.
criteria.residual: None in the design. None in enforcement.

criteria.design_coverage: No approved source means PROVENANCE_VERIFIED is unreachable. Proposed hosts are not approved.
criteria.missing: An approval that names a host

criteria.requirement: Receiver verifies graph and target compatibility
criteria.design_coverage: assert_dependency_graph plus an explicit fail while patch, SOABI, glibc, pip, or tags are unknown.
criteria.residual: Fail-closed is specified. The profile is not known.

criteria.design_coverage: Client checks server SID before any artifact byte. Server checks client SID. Pipe name is not identity.
criteria.residual: SID checks without this order are not accepted

criteria.design_coverage: Any other client SID fails closed and creates no file.
Nonce echo once. Unconfigured size or count maximum fails before storage. Name rules reject traversal, streams, devices, casefold, and non-NFC.
criteria.evidence: Name rules exist in tests/g14_7_fs.py. NFC and the unconfigured-maximum fail were not in that helper.
criteria.missing: Tests T through AA and AB AC
criteria.residual: Current helper is not the pipe parser

criteria.requirement: Publication only after all mandatory checks
criteria.design_coverage: Forward-only states. Missing provenance or target profile stops before commit.
criteria.evidence: State list in G.14.11. Not implemented.

criteria.requirement: Publication bound to the intended object
criteria.design_coverage: Commit record is FILE_CREATE on the still-open directory handle. It stores volume serial, file index, and receiver hashes.
criteria.evidence: Post-open binding was tested in G.14.8. Pre-open identity was not.
criteria.residual: File index alone can be reused after deletion. The contract forbids relying on it alone.

criteria.design_coverage: Receiver re-reads bytes on the open handle immediately before commit and again before consumer send. Mismatch fails. Interactive user is denied write.
criteria.residual: A compromised receiver can still write. That is not claimed.

criteria.design_coverage: Consumer checks server SID before reading payload bytes.
Consumer hashes and re-runs wheel checks on the bytes it received. It does not trust the commit alone.

criteria.requirement: Consumer does not reopen an attacker-replaceable path
criteria.design_coverage: Consumer has no path parameter for the published object. A path open reported as publication is a failure.
criteria.residual: A later private copy by this user is outside the claim

criteria.design_coverage: Receiver and consumer environments have no production mount. Production paths are refused and not opened.
criteria.evidence: This stage did not mount or open them
criteria.missing: A measured mount list of a future process

criteria.design_coverage: Receiver environment is a fixed allowlist. Backup filenames and .env names are rejected unread. No inherited user environment.
Socket path is not opened and is not in the allowlist.
criteria.missing: A test that the future process cannot open the pipe

criteria.requirement: No silent fallback to a weaker path workflow
criteria.design_coverage: Any path open of a sender-supplied or user-writable directory is FAILED_CLOSED, not a retry.
criteria.residual: tests/g14_7_fs.py open_directory remains a path open and must not be reused as the receiver entry

criteria.design_coverage: Unknown check, missing principal, missing ACL test, missing maximum, or missing target field is FAILED_CLOSED.

criteria.requirement: No modification of the running production container
criteria.design_coverage: Receiver plan does not stop, start, or retag it.
criteria.residual: A future build approval is separate

criteria.design_coverage: Safety files are not opened.
No database client and no inherited connection string.
Those mounts are refused and not opened.

note: DESIGN_SATISFIED means the clause is now specified. It does not mean Windows enforces it. G.14.11 left C03, C04, C06, C13, and C15 incomplete. The G.14.12 artifacts supply those clauses. Empirical status stays unverified.
